steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: The Sun Crow is drawing close to DisSea. Its power is growing stronger. The sorcery is barely holding up!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I... can still go on. Hold on, I can definitely catch it!

The green light of the sorcery flickers unsteadily, as if the distant heat binding the Sun Crow has traveled here. The casters all turn pale and are sweating profusely. Several sealers are about to collapse.

And what saves them at the critical moment is the scholar's gentle smoke. Du Ruo gives them a lukewarm smile. Bolstering the sorcery while healing the seers is no easy task and she can't afford to be distracted.
Yet she can't help but recall someone's question in her mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you don't believe in myths and worship no gods.
After all these years, now is finally her turn to be questioned.

She knows their differences are hard to overcome, that the lies will eventually be exposed, and that no one can escape the truth and their suffering. Everything is hard. She finally begins to feel somewhat powerless, her strength being drained bit by bit.
The smoke has cleared. She's a bit unsteady on her feet, her body probably falling backward. Her vision is blurring and blacking out. Even at this moment, she doesn't panic.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Since then, or even earlier, I've never stopped believing...
In places she can't see, there must still be someone...
Something cold touches her forehead, and Du Ruo opens her eyes, feeling she hasn't fainted for long. She hasn't fallen to the ground but is carefully supported by someone.
She hears a familiar yet slightly tired voice behind her. Du Ruo doesn't need to look to know who it is.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look at you. I don't think you'll get to tease me anymore. Why push yourself so hard?
Realizing this is not a dream, Du Ruo smiles.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...I mean, I've been under some bad influence.
